elements.label: Notion page UI cut away to blank card
elements.change_other: hard cut out (page, title, red frame strip replaced by blank off-white card in one frame)

pattern.description: Hard cut from the Notion demo to an empty off-white card; after a short beat of blank, the two-line feature headline rises in from below, line 1 slightly ahead of line 2, and settles centred.
pattern.why_premium: Same title-card treatment as the earlier feature headline (e021) gives the film a consistent chapter rhythm; the brief empty beat after the cut resets attention before the type lands with a fast ease-out.

build_hint.gsap: tl.set('.demo', {autoAlpha: 0}).set('.title-card', {autoAlpha: 1}).fromTo('.title-card .line', {yPercent: 60, opacity: 0}, {yPercent: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.35, ease: 'power3.out', stagger: 0.06}, '+=0.15')
build_hint.remotion: <Sequence from={cut}> title card; per line i: p = spring({frame: frame - delay - i*2, fps, config: {damping: 200, stiffness: 180}}); translateY = interpolate(p, [0,1], [40,0]); opacity = p. Demo sequence ends at cut (no transition).

notes: Mirrors e021 (same title-card build). The cut itself is a shot-level transition; b01 listed only to record the UI disappearing. Camera pan values reflect the content swap, not a camera move.
